lemmas.primary_translation: grounds for complaint or criticism; something to rely on

definitions.translation: grounds for complaint or criticism (lit. something to hang one's hat on)

examples.no: for den kompromissløse er det lett å finne noe å henge hatten sin på
examples.en: for someone who will not compromise, it is easy to find grounds for complaint or criticism

examples.no: arbeidet blir lettere når en hadde noe å henge hatten på
examples.en: the work becomes easier when one has something to rely on
